params.name: keyObject
params.description: JSON object containing the encryption key, with the same structure as the object returned by New data key

params.name: salt
params.description: Additional salt to make the encryption more robust

overloads.semanticRole: Encrypts a BLOB using an explicit encryption-key object (e.g. from New data key).

params.name: passPhrase
params.description: Passphrase used to generate the encryption key directly

params.name: salt
params.description: Additional salt to make the encryption more robust

overloads.semanticRole: Encrypts a BLOB using an encryption key derived directly from a passphrase string.

constraints: Uses the same algorithm 4D uses to encrypt data (AES-256).

The resulting encryptedBLOB length is always a multiple of 16 bytes; if blobToEncrypt is not itself a multiple of 16 bytes, null bytes are appended automatically, so callers working with non-text files must track the original size themselves to correctly decrypt with Decrypt data BLOB.
Returns False and an empty encryptedBLOB on error.
